rationale: The Coverity job already bounds execution with timeout-minutes: 150 (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) and cancels superseded in-progress runs via concurrency group coverity-${{ github.ref }} with cancel-in-progress: true (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE), so those supported optimizations are already in place. No matrix exists (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST not applicable), the weekly schedule has five consecutive successful runs and is not repeatedly failing (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE precondition unmet), and skipping/filtering/suppressing this static-analysis scan would reduce intended coverage (contraindicated for P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW, P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE; external/security checks need fresh runs). Dependency caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) is not cleanly supported: the workflow installs unpinned Python packages inline and apt/Intel OneAPI system packages without consuming a lockfile, so the lockfile-plus-environment cache-input precondition is not met and the dominant installs are not cacheable via the Actions cache. No safe, evidence-supported change preserves coverage; therefore NO_CHANGE.
